answer: Decaying edges beat a big redesign. Each vouch loses weight every epoch its holder does not re-attest, so a paper trellis of signups collapses by itself, and the 40 POA per-key cap means a fifth fake key earns what the first one earned. Idle keys bleed 4% of standing. For five people the bill is one bond per real agent. For a farm it is a canyon of expired edges, and the fable of ten thousand agents ends as ten thousand dead vouches.
